evidence_excerpts: Table 3 proposes study design features for mindfulness-based interventions, including teacher information, practice information, instructor adherence, control group use, randomization, adverse-event monitoring, participant criteria, prior meditation experience, and conflicts of interest.

Researchers should adopt more nuanced terminology, follow replication-crisis lessons such as preregistered experiments and open-science replications, and report contemplative-neuroscience findings with due modesty.
text: Future mindfulness research should use precise terminology, stronger construct measures, active controls, preregistration, adverse-event monitoring, detailed intervention reporting, and cautious public communication.
